summary: Add a single smoke marker file smoke/legion26u-1.md containing exactly one line. Sandbox repo; one file, one commit, no rebases unless GitHub reports a conflict.
steps: Create or overwrite smoke/legion26u-1.md so its entire content is exactly one line: `kind smoke legion26u 1 2026-09-15T05:14:51Z` (single trailing newline, no other lines, no other files touched).
Verify content with `cat -A smoke/legion26u-1.md` and `wc -l smoke/legion26u-1.md` (expect 1).
Commit as one commit; set bookmark legion/SLEGION26U-1; push; open PR with body line `Dispatch: SLEGION26U-1`.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: smoke/legion26u-1.md exists and its only line is exactly `kind smoke legion26u 1 2026-09-15T05:14:51Z`.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: repository file at HEAD of PR branch
acceptanceCriteria.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && cmp -s smoke/legion26u-1.md <(printf 'kind smoke legion26u 1 2026-09-15T05:14:51Z\n') && test "$(wc -l < smoke/legion26u-1.md)" = 1

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No other file is added, modified, or deleted by this change.

implement: legion-worker: write the file, single commit, set bookmark legion/SLEGION26U-1, push, open PR with `Dispatch: SLEGION26U-1`; content must be byte-exact, verify with cat -A/cmp.
test: legion-worker: re-run the byte-exact cmp/wc check against the pushed head and confirm the PR diff touches only smoke/legion26u-1.md; production-like surface is the repository file at the PR head.
review: legion-worker: confirm on GitHub the diff is exactly one line in one file; docs-only PR so no thermo pass.

notes: Sandbox sjawhar/legion-smoke: keep change to the one named file, one commit, no rebases unless GitHub reports CONFLICTING. Overwrite if the file already exists.
